title: Move context and plural support to `Translation`
body:
This PR is separated into 3 commits for easier review.

## 1. Move plural rules logic into a separate class

This commit extracts plural rules logic in `TranslationPO` into a new `PluralRules` class. Making it easier to move and improve the logic related to plurals.

During refactoring, I found that the original caching logic was caching the plural index for the recent "untranslated string, context, N" triple. Plural indices are only related to N, so the use of triples is unnecessary. Caching only for successive queries for the same N also results in a low cache hit rate. So I changed the caching mechanism to use `LRUCache<int, int>`.

Tests are also added for the new `PluralRules` class.

## 2. Add default plural rules

This makes the PO & MO file loader correctly handle the situation where the optional `Plural-Forms` header field does not exist.

The `Translation` class and its subclasses always have access to a valid `PluralRule` via `_get_plural_rules()`. Plural rules are selected in the following order.

1. `Translation.plural_rules_override`
2. `TranslationServer.get_plural_rules(locale)`
3. The English plural rules: `nplurals=2; plurals=(n != 1)`

This is implemented on `Translation` instead of `TranslationPO` because the plural rule needs to react to locale change when not overridden with `plural_rules_override`.

The default plural rules are taken from #101471.

## 3. Move context and plural support to Translation

With plural rules logic ironed out, it's easier to move context and plural support from `TranslationPO` to `Translation`.

The main difference compared to `TranslationPO` is how the messages are stored. `TranslationPO` uses a nested hashmap (`map[context][untranslated-string]`) while `Translation` uses a regular one (with context and untranslated-string as the key). Using different hashmaps for different contexts wastes space and is not friendly to meaningful traversal.

All existing `Translation` methods are still compatible. Notably, to keep compatible with the old `get_message_list()`, the context is prefixed to the untranslated string in the format that MO files use, if a context exists. Legacy code that does not utilize contexts does not need to change.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b724c4c8f65c65ef3d3bc8f2a7139bb9c40ca509/doc/classes/Translation.xml#L76-L92

After this PR:

- `TranslationPO` becomes an empty class. It exists for compatibility.
- `OptimizedTranslation` stays the same, no context or plural support are added. But this lays the groundwork for them.
